students.source: reciprocal of the entry in yahya-ibn-said-al-qattan's record (Tahdhib al-Tahdhib)

tadlis.source: Ibn Hajar, Tabaqat al-Mudallisin, rank 1, no. 32, https://shamela.ws/book/1186/23
tadlis.note: «تابعي صغير مشهور، وصفه بذلك علي ابن المديني فيما ذكره عبد الغني بن سعيد الأزدي، وكذا وصفه به الدارقطني». Rank 1: those described as mudallis only rarely; Ibn Hajar names him as the type of the rank.

flags.label: Negligible tadlis
flags.detail: Yahya al-Qattan said he “memorised and used the ambiguous formula”; Ibn Hajar placed him in the first rank of mudallisin, those who did it so rarely they should not be counted as such. Here he says “informed me” in any case.

bio: A judge in Madinah and later, for al-Mansur, in Iraq; a Madinan scholar of the Ansar, among the junior Successors (he met Anas ibn Malik); his grandfather Qays ibn Amr was a Companion. Malik, the two Sufyans, Shu'ba, Hammad ibn Zayd and many others learned from him, and this hadith became famous through his students.
